'''Moon snails''' are a species of [[hateable]] [[vermin]] found inhabiting [[temperate]] [[ocean]]s. They will cause unhappy [[thought]]s in [[Dwarf|dwarves]] who absolutely detest them should they encounter one. They possess a [[pet]] value of 10, but may not be caught in [[animal trap]]s.

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] moon snails for their ''predatory nature'' and their ''striking coloration''.
